alloy.preparation: Equiatomic FeSiBAlNi powders made from elemental Fe, Si, B, Al and Ni powders above 99.5 wt% purity and below 70 µm. Mechanically alloyed in a planetary ball mill at 350 r/min for 240 h under argon at room temperature, using stainless-steel cylinder/balls and 15:1 ball:powder mass ratio; after every 30 min milling, halted for 30 min. As-milled powders spark-plasma sintered in graphite die (Dr. Sinter-3.20MKII) at 520 °C for 10 min, heating 40 °C/min under axial 80 MPa and argon, then freely cooled to room temperature. Compactness/shape assessed and surface ground with 2000-grit SiC before electrochemistry.
alloy.microstructure: At 520 °C SPS, partially crystallized amorphous composite containing fcc1 and bcc1 solid-solution phases and residual amorphous phase; particle-like morphology below 3 µm with agglomerated particles. The fully amorphous milled powder and fully crystallized 1080 °C SPS product are distinct states.

test_solution.preparation: Artificial seawater prepared by dissolving artificial sea salt in distilled water at reported salt:water mass ratio 1:30. No individual salt recipe, pH or gas conditioning supplied.

amount.unit: mass part per 30 mass parts distilled water

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell with bulk FeSiBAlNi working electrode, Pt counter and Ag/AgCl reference; CHI 760E potentiostat. Sweep after OCP had sufficiently stabilized; stabilization time and potential range are not given. The paper explicitly states room temperature only for the separate immersion tests; no numerical polarization temperature is supplied.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit explicitly identified in Section 3.4 and Figure 5 at the passive-to-active transition; no fixed current-density criterion is stated.

experiments.result_note: The explicit text Epit is selected as primary. Fig. 5 places the labeled Epit guide near −0.68 V, which conflicts with the printed −0.56 V. Both readings are retained without resolving the source discrepancy. The 1080°C curve is described as anodic dissolution without a passive plateau and supplies no Epit. Nominal equiatomic formula coefficients are retained without calculating 20 at% or a bulk weight analysis. The 520 °C label is SPS processing temperature, not electrolyte temperature. The seawater ratio is copied without conversion to wt% or chloride concentration.
